We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $8.6T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes - from emerging brands to Fortune 500s - use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. At a valuation of $8 billion, we’re experiencing record growth and are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

Creating insights to revolutionize an industry!

Fast, accurate insights are integral in allowing us to fulfill our mission of fixing the user experience in global trade. At Flexport you’ll conduct analyses that are at the forefront of reshaping the entire logistics & supply chain industries.

You’ll work alongside self-starters interested in solving real-world problems and streamlining the inefficiencies in the complex global trade industry. You’ll have the opportunity to improve an industry by analyzing the new operating system for global trade.

· Flexport is a company that runs on data - you'll be transforming data into action by working cross-functionally with the entirety of Flexport.

· Meet with stakeholders - from business and product - to understand OKR requirements and convert them into analytical solutions

· Model new product analytics datasets built on our proprietary operations software to optimize growth strategies and cost reductions

· Improve operational and financial productivity across our business and software

· Rapid prototype new functionality via dashboards to enable new ways of working and discover best practices for workflow management across all of Flexport's departments;

· Contribute and grow the culture of excellence on our team by bringing processes and best practices to our group.

· Drive highly visible projects for Flexport

· Influence the roadmap for both the Data Analytics department and the stakeholders we support

· 1-5 years of experience in a Data Analyst, BI Engineer, Product Analyst, or similar role

· Strong SQL fluency required – from building entire ERDs of tables containing complex logic to analyzing those datasets into consumable insights for the business.

· Experience ELT data modeling, especially with dbt (data build tool) is a plus; building analytical narratives using data visualizations (Looker is a plus)

· Executive communication skills and empathy to understand and discover business pain points and build solutions to improve the user experience at all levels of the global trade process

· Interest in optimizing operational productivity and measuring automation across our software and business processes

· familiarity with applied statistics and scripting languages like Python or R

Worried about not having any logistics experience?

Don’t be! Our mission is to make global trade easy for everyone. That’s why it’s important to bring people from diverse backgrounds and experiences together with our industry veterans to help move the global logistics industry forward.

We know this industry is complex. That’s why we invest in education starting day one with Flexport Academy, a one week intensive onboarding program designed specifically to set every new Flexport employee up for success.

Team description
The Central Product Analytics team sits at the heart of how SumUp understands and improves the experience of millions of merchants using our products every day.

This role owns the Engagement domain — covering merchant engagement, product activation, support responses, and navigation across the SuperApp and web dashboard — and is the primary analytics partner for the Engagement product team.

It's a genuine opportunity to take full ownership of a domain, build the measurement foundations from the ground up, and shift the team from reactive reporting to proactive, insight-led decision-making.

Define event taxonomies and measurement plans, implement and QA tracking (GA4), and make sure analytics is built into new product features from day one
Build and maintain scalable datasets in Snowflake — including funnels, customer behaviour models, and feature adoption metrics — and use them to generate insights that directly inform product decisions
Design and evaluate A/B tests: define success metrics, assess statistical validity, and communicate results clearly to product and engineering stakeholders
Create and maintain intuitive dashboards and reusable query templates in Tableau that help teams answer their own questions without always needing an analyst
Partner with product managers to develop and map out KPI trees, identify measurement gaps, and improve the quality and accuracy of engagement tracking across the domain
You'll be great for this role if…
Proven experience as a Data or Product Analyst, with a strong track record of working with customer behaviour data and translating it into product decisions.
Advanced proficiency in SQL, including writing, optimising, and validating queries, building data models, and participating in code reviews.
Strong knowledge of data visualisation tools such as Tableau or Power BI, and experience with data warehousing platforms like Snowflake, Postgres, or Redshift.
Comfortable designing and analysing end-to-end experiments, including A/B tests and feature flag rollouts, with a solid understanding of statistical validity.
Ability to communicate complex data findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, with strong written and verbal English skills.

About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences.

We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc.

(Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

At Tripadvisor experiences, the only thing we love more than travel is data. We slice it, we dice it, and we use it to empower our decision making.

· Working as one of the leaders within the Product Analytics team and closely with the Product Pod, you will be the lead analyst responsible for driving improvement in the product, through data, analytics and insight.

· Lead on Experimentation and AB Testing as a key element of the role, where you will run the analysis for any tests, using our in house system and mentor others.

· Product Analytics at Viator is about finding opportunities to improve customer experience, this is through many aspects but would include Funnel, Feature and Cohort Analysis.

· It's also about Realising those opportunities, working with the Product Pod to provide insight that drives change, either through AB Testing or Release.

· In supporting the Objectives and Key Results we’re looking to drive, you will play a key role in creating reporting, analytics and insight views, that help the team to understand the product, the customer and commercial performance, whilst guiding others to do the same.

· Talking about the customer, we’re not just talking about one group, so segmentation, cohorts and customer understanding are at the heart of the role.

· Significant Experience in a related analytical role, (ideal background may include Product Analyst, Data Science - Product, CRO, Digital Analytics, or Experimentation Analyst)

· Education: Bachelor's Degree in an analytical field (maths, economics, engineering, statistics, computer science etc)

· Skills - Advanced SQL, AB Testing / Experimentation, Tableau/Looker, Excel etc

· Proactive - ability to lead the analytics discussions , driving change, shaping approach

· Knowledge - ideally you will have knowledge of and worked in a Product Analytics or similar role, covering AB Testing, Conversion Optimisation, Funnel and Feature Analysis

· Customer Focus - having a passion for customer understanding and their experience, you will have experience of Segmentation and Cohort Analysis.

· Collaboration - Your previous experience will have given the opportunity to work with Product, Engineering, Design etc, as part of a Product Approach.

· Critical Thinking - Your previous experience will demonstrate the analysis of available facts, evidence, observations, and arguments in order to form a judgment by the application of rational, skeptical, and unbiased analyses and evaluation.

· Leadership - You demonstrate the best approach to analytical problems, applying critical thinking, you lead others by example in executing best practices

We’re looking for a Staff Product Analyst to join our growing Product Analytics team and serve as a strategic partner to Grafana’s AI organization . This role will support the teams building Grafana Assistant , our synchronous chat experience; Investigations , our asynchronous AI workflow for incident analysis; and AI observability solutions , including Agent Observability .
You will shape how the AI team measures success by defining KPIs, improving measurement practices, guiding experiment design and evaluation, and translating data into recommendations that influence product decisions.
This is a highly cross-functional role. You’ll work closely with Product, Design, Engineering, and Data partners, with a primary focus on supporting the AI team, and report to the Product Analytics Manager
If you’re excited about building strong product analytics capabilities and using data to shape the future of AI-powered experiences at Grafana , we’d love to hear from you.
You Will
Partner cross functionally across Product to establish top-level KPIs, dashboards, and product roadmap planning
Define how success is measured for AI-powered product experiences, including adoption, engagement, quality, retention, and user outcomes
Guide the instrumentation of product data in collaboration with our Product Design, Product Management, and Engineering teams to enable reliable analysis of AI features and workflows.
Design, evaluate, and interpret experiments to assess the impact of new AI capabilities and inform product decisions.
Develop dbt models to transform and test our user behavior data in partnership with our Analytics Engineering team
Influence best practices for Product Analytics across teams and help define standards as the company scales
Contribute to defining the long-term vision and strategy for Product Analytics, balancing near-term needs with scalable, durable solutions.
You have
Experience partnering across product and engineering organizations, and familiarity with typical product KPIs and frameworks (e.g., DAU/MAU, funnels, A/B testing)
Experience defining and tracking success metrics for complex product areas, ideally including AI-powered features or workflows.
SQL: writing complex yet efficient SQL is a daily habit for you
Data Visualization: experience with any of the following tools: Tableau, Looker, Omni, Hex, or of course, Grafana!
Experience writing dbt models, implementing Product Analytics tooling (e.g., Heap, Pendo, Amplitude, FullStory), and code version control (git)
Experience using AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) to quickly prototype and iterate across analysis, data modeling, instrumentation, visualization and code development.
Excellent communication skills, able to explain technical topics to non-technical audiences, and maintain many of the essential cross-team and cross-functional relationships necessary for the team’s success
A plus if you have
Knowledge about observability
Familiarity with Airflow or Prefect - generating ad hoc ETL jobs

Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.

Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.

We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.

The role is responsible for driving data-driven insights and strategies to fuel user acquisition, engagement, and retention for verticals within Careem. The role holder will leverage advanced data analytics and prior grasp of key fundamental growth metrics to define and analyze growth opportunities, optimize campaigns and initiatives and improve key metrics such as CLTV, CAC, AOV and ARPU

Data Collection and Preparation

· Extract Data: Retrieve data from multiple sources (SQL databases, APIs, and third-party tools) to support analysis

· Data Cleaning and Wrangling: Prepare and clean datasets to ensure accuracy and usability for analysis

· Maintain Data Integrity: Regularly verify and maintain data quality, ensuring consistent and reliable information for decision-making

· Automate Data Pipelines: Develop and refine scripts to automate repetitive data tasks, improving efficiency.

Analysis and Insights

· Conduct Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA): Perform preliminary analysis to uncover trends, patterns, and initial insights at channel, vertical and campaign level

· A/B Testing: Design, run, and analyze A/B tests to measure the effectiveness of growth initiatives.

· User Behavior Analysis: Analyze user activity, segment performance, and identify key behavior trends to support user growth, engagement, and retention.

· Predictive Analysis: Apply advanced statistical techniques to forecast trends and potential outcomes.

Reporting and Visualization

· Build Dashboards: Develop and maintain dashboards (e.g., in Tableau, Power BI) to provide real-time insights to stakeholders.

· Generate Regular Reports: Create and distribute weekly and monthly reports on key metrics and performance indicators.

· Visualize Data: Present insights through clear visualizations to make complex data understandable and actionable.

· KPI Tracking: Track and report on core growth KPIs, including retention, churn, and acquisition metrics

What You'll Need

· 2-4 years of proven experience in a similar role preferably in a large Scale B2C startup (Food delivery, e-commerce) or consumer internet business

· Strong hold of Python, SQL and data visualization tools (Power BI, VBA, Tableau) and Powerpoint - Strong understanding of A/B Testing, Regression Analysis, User Segmentation, Cohort analysis and churn/attrition modeling, CLTV models

· Bachelor’s degree in Engineering/Mathematics/Statistics

· Certifications in Data Intelligence/BI reporting/ AI preferred

· AI first mindset, comfortable with AI models, skills, MCP, connectors.

· Well versed in data mining, statistical modeling and advanced data analysis

· Good communication skills with ability to effectively present results to both technical and non-technical audience

What we’ll provide you

We offer colleagues the opportunity to drive impact in the region while they learn and grow. As a full time Careem colleague, you will be able to:

· Work and learn from great minds by joining a community of inspiring colleagues.

· Put your passion to work in a purposeful organisation dedicated to creating impact in a region with a lot of untapped potential.

· Explore new opportunities to learn and grow every day.

· Work 4 days a week in office & 1 day from home, and remotely from any country in the world for 30 days a year with unlimited vacation days per year. (If you are in an individual contributor role in tech, you will have 2 office days a week and 3 to work from home.)

· Access to healthcare benefits and fitness reimbursements for health activities including gym, health club, and training classes.

EBANX is one of the most successful fintechs to emerge from Latin America — and today, we are building a truly global payments company. Our mission has remained constant from day one: to unlock access and enable companies and consumers to participate in the digital economy, no matter where they are.

What started as a bold vision has grown into a platform that connects some of the world’s largest digital businesses with customers across 21 of the fastest-growing markets. We operate where complexity exists — turning local challenges into global opportunities, and building the infrastructure that allows payments to move further, faster, and smarter.

We are a team of builders and problem-solvers. We think globally, act with curiosity, and believe diversity of thought is a competitive advantage.

As EBANX enters its next phase of hyper growth, we are looking for people who want to shape the future of payments, expand what’s possible, and help connect businesses and consumers across borders.

Let’s build what’s next — together.

At EBANX’s Product Performance team, you don’t just create features. You develop user-centered solutions that transform the experience of millions of consumers and global companies. Every product decision has a real impact on the future of digital payments, combining strategic vision, innovation, and collaboration to make our work truly Out Of The Ordinary .

As a Senior Product Analyst for Payments Performance, you will play a key role in ensuring the performance, reliability, and continuous evolution of our card products and payment platform. You will be responsible for identifying, analyzing, and implementing strategies to improve critical capabilities such as Network Token, Card-on-File, Account Updater, and 3DS, while maintaining operational excellence across multiple markets.

Working closely with Engineering, Operations, Commercial teams, and external partners, you will leverage data and analytical insights to optimize authorization rates, strengthen redundancy strategies across countries and providers, and drive discovery initiatives that unlock new opportunities to improve payment performance and merchant experience.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, working cross-functionally, and combining analytical thinking with product strategy to continuously enhance the performance and scalability of a global payments ecosystem.

s.h: What your day-to-day will look like
s.t:
· Own and continuously improve card performance capabilities such as Network Token, Card-on-File, Account Updater, 3DS, and other products that impact authorization rates and merchant experience.

· Analyze payment performance metrics, identify trends and opportunities, and drive data-driven initiatives to improve conversion, reliability, and operational excellence across multiple markets.

· Partner closely with Engineering, Operations, Commercial teams, and external partners to investigate issues, prioritize opportunities, and deliver solutions that enhance payment performance.

· Lead discovery initiatives and evaluate new technologies, providers, and strategies to increase approval rates, strengthen redundancy between countries and partners, and expand our product capabilities.

· Establish and maintain monitoring frameworks, KPIs, and processes that ensure continuous optimization and scalability of the payments ecosystem.

· Stay up to date with industry trends and payment technologies to ensure our products remain competitive and aligned with market best practices.

What you need to shine in this role

· Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Technology, or a related field.

· Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify patterns, and translate insights into product decisions.

· Experience working with cross-functional teams and driving initiatives in a fast-paced environment.

· Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.

· Ownership mindset, curiosity, and a proactive approach to problem-solving and continuous improvement.

· Ability to leverage AI-powered tools to accelerate analysis, documentation, and execution, while applying sound judgment and business context to drive decisions.

· Experience in payments, fintech, e-commerce, or related industries.

· Familiarity with card products and technologies such as Network Token, Account Updater, Card-on-File, 3DS, smart routing, or anti-fraud solutions.

· Experience working with payment providers, acquirers, issuers, and card schemes.

· Familiarity with analytics and observability tools such as SQL, Datadog, Kibana, Grafana, or Looker.

· Experience with iterative product development and experimentation.

· Professional proficiency in Portuguese, English, and Spanish.

As companies scale, the gap between what leadership needs to see and what teams can easily report grows — dashboards get built by hand, workflows stay stuck in spreadsheets, and requests for better tooling pile up faster than they get solved. This role exists to close that gap: turning manual reporting into trusted, self-serve data products, finding and fixing the workflows costing teams the most time, and helping make sure the highest-impact tooling requests actually get built.

The Internal Tools & Data Product Analyst partners with business teams to find where manual work, inconsistent data, or missing tooling is slowing things down, and helps turn that into a shipped fix.

This might mean defining what a metric actually means and getting a dashboard built around it, helping retire a spreadsheet-driven process that shouldn't exist anymore, or helping triage and prioritize a backlog of tool requests.

Some of this gets shipped directly — lightweight builds, AI-assisted coding — and the rest gets scoped into a clear spec and handed to an engineering partner.

Partner with business stakeholders to help define what key metrics actually mean, and support getting agreement on a single trusted source for each one.

Help prioritize which reports or metrics get automated first, based on how manual, stale, or error-prone they are today.
Workflow Automation
Identify manual, spreadsheet-driven work worth automating, and help see the fix through end to end.
Scope each fix and help decide what to build directly (lightweight scripting, no-code tools, AI-assisted coding) versus what needs a full engineering build.
Write clear, engineering-ready specs for anything handed off to a technical partner.
Identify and document places where an AI agent or automation could replace manual coordination, feeding the broader automation roadmap.
Intake & Prioritization
Support the tool-request pipeline: help collect requests, triage them, and prioritize based on impact versus effort.
Help maintain a visible roadmap so stakeholders understand what's coming next and why.
Build relationships with the teams you support so priorities stay grounded in what they actually need.

Reduction in manual, spreadsheet-driven work across supported teams
Dashboard/reporting trust and adoption
A tool-request pipeline that is visible, current, and trusted by stakeholders
Time saved per reporting or workflow cycle
